name: ClickHouse MCP
tagline: Run fast analytical SQL queries against ClickHouse from your AI agent.
shortDescription: The official ClickHouse MCP server. Lets your agent run SQL queries against a ClickHouse database — the column-oriented analytics engine used by Cloudflare, Uber, and many others. Sub-second response times on billion-row tables.
longDescription:
## What it is

The ClickHouse MCP server, maintained by ClickHouse Inc. Exposes the ClickHouse HTTP interface as MCP tools: run queries, list databases and tables, inspect schemas, insert data in batches, and manage dictionaries.

## Why we recommend it

If you have analytical workloads (event data, time series, large aggregations), ClickHouse is the right database and this is the right way to access it from your agent. Sub-second query times on billion-row tables. The server supports both ClickHouse Cloud and self-hosted clusters.

## When to use it

- Analytics agents that answer questions about user behavior
- Time series exploration: agent runs queries against metrics or events
- Log analysis at scale (the kind that makes Postgres cry)
- OLAP workloads where you want sub-second latency
installInstructions:
1. Get a ClickHouse connection string (Cloud or self-hosted)
2. Set: `CLICKHOUSE_HOST`, `CLICKHOUSE_USER`, `CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD`, `CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE`
3. `uvx mcp-clickhouse`

**Production:** Use a read-only user for safe agent access. ClickHouse's query log will show what the agent ran.
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. ClickHouse is open source. ClickHouse Cloud has a free tier.
